svg.aria-label: Which states hold which counterspace capabilities, by decade
svg.title: Which states hold which counterspace capabilities, by decade
svg.desc: Number of states holding each capability in each decade. Solid fill: capability demonstrated (tested or used). Striped fill: developing or latent, as the SWF country tables support. Dotted fill: developing, our reading, for 2020s entries where the SWF tables show no data. Faded fill with a dashed edge: decades before the 2020s, which we reconstructed from SWF’s test tables and country chapters; SWF did not assess them. The range above each decade runs from capabilities demonstrated only (low end) to demonstrated plus developing (high end). Bar height counts each state once for every capability it holds, so a state with two capabilities counts twice.

text.style: fill:rgb(14, 20, 34);font:500 29px Newsreader,"Iowan Old Style","Palatino Linotype",Palatino,"Book Antiqua",Georgia,serif

svg.text: Which states hold which counterspace capabilities, by decade

text.style: fill:#3c4660;font:400 14.5px "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Number of states holding each capability in each decade.

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);fill-opacity:1;stroke:none;stroke-width:1px;stroke-dasharray:none;stroke-opacity:1;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;font-variant-numeric:normal;letter-spacing:normal;text-anchor:start;text-transform:none;display:inline;paint-order:normal

svg.desc: Stacked bars of the number of pairs of a state and a capability for each decade from the 1950s to the 2020s. Solid fills are demonstrated capabilities, striped fills are developing or latent ones and faded bars are decades reconstructed without an SWF assessment. A data table follows the chart.

svg.text: Solid fill: capability demonstrated (tested or used). Striped fill: developing or latent, as the SWF country tables support. Dotted fill: developing, our reading, for 2020s entries where the SWF tables show

text.style: fill:#3c4660;font:400 12px "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: no data. Faded fill with a dashed edge: decades before the 2020s, which we reconstructed from SWF’s test tables and country chapters; SWF did not assess them. The range above each decade runs from

text.style: fill:#3c4660;font:400 12px "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: capabilities demonstrated only (low end) to demonstrated plus developing (high end). Bar height counts each state once for every capability it holds, so a state with two capabilities counts twice.

text.style: fill:#3c4660;font:400 12px "IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: Source: SWF 2026 (Secure World Foundation, Global Counterspace Capabilities: An Open Source Assessment, 9th ed., Apr. 2026) and the primary sources cited on the page.
